related.title: Zeek：內容缺口與可觀測流量的分母
related.titleEn: Zeek: content gaps and observable-traffic denominators
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付24格時間表、鏈接檢查、原始摘要與來源檔清單，以及真實簽章驗證尚未執行的明確註記。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the 24-slot timeline, link checks, digest/file manifests and an explicit statement that real signature validation was not performed.
related.difference: 把成功重組bytes、已知缺口bytes、連線狀態與監測區間分欄，對未觀察到的封包保留未知。
related.differenceEn: Separate reassembled bytes, known gaps, connection state and observation interval, retaining unknowns for unobserved traffic.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課計算的是時間窗口覆蓋，不是密碼安全機率；自編雜湊鏈不能冒充AWS簽章驗證。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 24個預期小時，各有一個教學摘要槽位；其中2小時未啟用收錄，另1個摘要缺失，其餘21個可核對。 可核對時間覆蓋21/24=87.5%；未啟用與遺失共3小時應各自列出。
教學內容可觀測率=成功重組/(成功重組+已知缺口)；僅在兩者互斥且涵蓋同一內容區間時成立。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 合成TCP內容區間10000bytes，成功重組9900，已知缺口100；不計重傳與協定標頭。 內容可觀測率9900/10000=99%；不能由此推出99%的事件或封包已被偵測。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Measure time-window coverage rather than cryptographic security probability; a teaching hash chain is not AWS signature validation. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Twenty-four expected hourly slots include two disabled intervals and one missing digest; twenty-one remain locally checkable. Checkable temporal coverage is 21/24=87.5%; list the three uncovered hours by distinct cause.

Teaching content visibility is reassembled/(reassembled+known gaps), assuming disjoint accounting over the same content interval. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. A synthetic TCP content interval spans 10000 bytes, with 9900 reassembled and 100 missing, excluding retransmissions and protocol headers. Content visibility is 99%; this does not imply that 99% of packets or security-relevant events were detected.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: NIST統計：小樣本偵測率的Wilson下限
related.titleEn: NIST statistics: Wilson lower bounds for small-sample detection rates
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付24格時間表、鏈接檢查、原始摘要與來源檔清單，以及真實簽章驗證尚未執行的明確註記。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the 24-slot timeline, link checks, digest/file manifests and an explicit statement that real signature validation was not performed.
related.difference: 保存每次測試的二元結果、抽樣規則與失敗樣本，區分觀測比例及未知母體比例。
related.differenceEn: Preserve binary outcomes, sampling rules and failures, distinguishing an observed fraction from an unknown population proportion.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課計算的是時間窗口覆蓋，不是密碼安全機率；自編雜湊鏈不能冒充AWS簽章驗證。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 24個預期小時，各有一個教學摘要槽位；其中2小時未啟用收錄，另1個摘要缺失，其餘21個可核對。 可核對時間覆蓋21/24=87.5%；未啟用與遺失共3小時應各自列出。

使用雙側95%Wilson區間下端，z=1.96；獨立同分布假設若不成立，不能把重複樣本當更多資訊。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 基準20次獨立合成測試成功18次，p̂=0.9；改變樣本為200次成功180次，比例相同。 下端=[p̂+z²/(2n)−z√(p̂(1−p̂)/n+z²/(4n²))]/[1+z²/n]；n=20得到69.896179%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Measure time-window coverage rather than cryptographic security probability; a teaching hash chain is not AWS signature validation. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Twenty-four expected hourly slots include two disabled intervals and one missing digest; twenty-one remain locally checkable. Checkable temporal coverage is 21/24=87.5%; list the three uncovered hours by distinct cause.

Use the lower endpoint of a two-sided 95% Wilson interval with z=1.96; correlated repeats violate the independent-trial interpretation. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. The baseline has eighteen successes in twenty independent synthetic trials; the larger sample has 180 successes in 200 trials. The lower endpoint is [p̂+z²/(2n)−z√(p̂(1−p̂)/n+z²/(4n²))]/[1+z²/n]; n=20 gives 69.896179%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
